description: Pre-publish campaign link check. Builds a UTM-tagged link, validates the destination URL, and inspects the page for social sharing readiness (Open Graph tags, Twitter Cards, viewport, canonical URL, favicon, UTM conflicts). Returns a go/no-go report with recommendations. Use this before publishing any campaign link.

medium.description: Marketing medium, e.g. social, cpc, email

share.description: Publish a shareable report URL (Team plan)

source.description: Traffic source, e.g. linkedin, google, newsletter

url.description: Destination URL (must be a valid URL)

name: mlz_preflight
